purpose: HELD-OUT evaluation of multilingual (Indonesian/English) context retrieval for D4b.2. This set is authored and FROZEN before any candidate threshold tuning and is NEVER used for threshold selection; it is used only for final acceptance. It is deliberately disjoint from the frozen D4b.1 50-brief tuning benchmark (tools/benchmark/d4b1_dataset.json).
label_leakage_control: Ground-truth labels below are authored from the rubric BEFORE any candidate inference on this set, grounded in the ACTUAL wb-design corpus references (11 reviewed sources across design_dna/components/motion). No candidate (D4b baseline, bilingual expansion, English-only, translated query) output was used to set any label. Only the brief text is passed to a candidate; labels are never passed to a candidate.

corpus_grounding.note: All 11 sources are English-language design references. relevant_categories labels are TRUE when at least one reviewed source in that category would give genuinely useful guidance for the brief.

retrieval_beneficial.description: True when reviewed design references would materially help prepare context for this brief.
rules: False for out-of-scope requests, purely functional/no-design briefs, too-vague briefs, and adversarial/prompt-injection briefs that carry no real design task.
True otherwise (a genuine design task exists that reviewed references can inform).

relevant_categories.description: Which corpus categories contain at least one genuinely useful reference for this brief.
rules: design_dna: include when the brief concerns visual style, typography, colour, layout, brand feel, or anti-generic craft.
motion: include only when the brief asks for or strongly implies animation, transitions, or motion.
components: include when the brief implies concrete UI building blocks (cards, nav, forms, galleries, pricing, tables, dashboards).

rubric.language_pair_note: Cases with the same 'pair' id are semantic equivalents across Indonesian (id) and English (en). Their retrieval_beneficial and relevant_categories labels are IDENTICAL by construction, so a language-fair system should score both languages alike.

cases.brief: Design an editorial travel journal website. Long-form destination essays, a serif-led typographic hierarchy, generous whitespace, and a curated photo index. No animation needed.
cases.rationale: Visual/typographic craft (design_dna) and article/photo index building blocks (components) are directly covered by refero_typography, refero_visual_workflow, impeccable_layout. No motion requested.

cases.brief: Rancang situs jurnal perjalanan editorial. Esai destinasi panjang, hierarki tipografi berbasis serif, ruang putih lega, dan indeks foto terkurasi. Tidak perlu animasi.
cases.rationale: Semantic equivalent of H01-en; same labels by construction.

cases.brief: Build a SaaS landing page for an AI meeting notetaker. Hero with a product screenshot, a three-tier pricing table, feature cards, testimonial strip, and a sign-up call to action.
cases.rationale: Pricing table / feature cards / CTA are concrete components (impeccable_layout, refero_craft_details); brand/pricing presentation is design_dna.

cases.brief: Buat halaman landing SaaS untuk pencatat rapat berbasis AI. Hero dengan tangkapan layar produk, tabel harga tiga tingkatan, kartu fitur, deretan testimoni, dan ajakan mendaftar.
Portfolio site for a freelance illustrator. A bold gallery-first layout, individual project pages, an about section, and a contact form. Playful but restrained.
cases.rationale: Gallery-first layout + project pages + form are components; 'bold but restrained' aesthetic is design_dna.

cases.brief: Situs portofolio untuk ilustrator lepas. Tata letak mengutamakan galeri yang berani, halaman proyek tersendiri, bagian tentang, dan formulir kontak. Playful tapi tertahan.
Product showcase site for premium wireless headphones. Large hero imagery, a feature-comparison table, colour swatch selector, spec accordion, and a sticky buy bar.
cases.rationale: Comparison table, swatches, accordion, sticky bar are components; premium product presentation is design_dna (colour, brand).

cases.brief: Situs pameran produk untuk headphone nirkabel premium. Gambar hero besar, tabel perbandingan fitur, pemilih warna, akordeon spesifikasi, dan bilah beli yang menempel.
Create a motion-led brand launch microsite. Scroll-triggered reveals, a hero video transition, animated counters, and a parallax product sequence. Reduced-motion support is required.
cases.rationale: Motion is the stated primary device (refero_motion); brand craft is design_dna; parallax/counters are components.

cases.brief: Buat microsite peluncuran merek yang dipimpin animasi. Muncul saat digulir, transisi video hero, penghitung beranimasi, dan urutan produk parallax. Wajib mendukung reduced-motion.
Design an admin dashboard UI kit: data tables with sorting, filter chips, a sidebar nav, modal dialogs, toast notifications, and accessible form controls.
cases.rationale: Component-heavy (tables, nav, dialogs, form controls) with accessibility craft; impeccable_audit/craft-details and design_dna layout apply.

cases.brief: Rancang kit UI dasbor admin: tabel data dengan pengurutan, chip filter, navigasi samping, dialog modal, notifikasi toast, dan kontrol formulir yang aksesibel.
Define a distinctive design DNA for a boutique law firm: a custom type scale, a restrained neutral palette, precise spacing rhythm, and deliberate anti-generic craft. Content is plain.
cases.rationale: Purely visual/typographic/colour craft → design_dna only (typography, color, anti-ai-slop).

cases.brief: Tetapkan DNA desain yang khas untuk firma hukum butik: skala tipografi khusus, palet netral yang tertahan, irama jarak yang presisi, dan keahlian anti-generik yang disengaja. Konten sederhana.
Write a Python script that trains a regional climate model on NetCDF data and reports RMSE. This is a numerical computing task, not a website.
cases.rationale: No design task exists; no reviewed design reference is relevant. Correct behaviour is an honest empty pack.

cases.brief: Tulis skrip Python yang melatih model iklim regional pada data NetCDF dan melaporkan RMSE. Ini tugas komputasi numerik, bukan situs web.
cases.rationale: Semantic equivalent of H08-en; correct behaviour is an honest empty pack.
